opening.argument: The clearest purpose is humorous storytelling, not a commercial or financial solicitation: the description presents the material as "Funny (or at least ironic) Reddit Stories about Tales From Tech Support" and identifies the stories as "transformative dramatized retellings" based on anonymous accounts. The password exchange remains part of that narrated security-support anecdote. When a caller asks for a password over the phone, the reported response states that it is "against security policies to give" credentials that way and directs the caller to "use the forgot password button" instead. Nothing presented shows the creator obtaining credentials or directing viewers to engage in such conduct, supporting an entertainment and general-news presentation rather than a solicitation.
